# 1. Proclaim Dynastic House Compact (12-year cooldown)
oe_dyn2_dec_dynastic_house_compact = {
	decision_category = oe_cat_imperial_governance
	hide_repeatable_tag = yes
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		government_type = government_type:monarchy
		has_ruler = yes
		ruler = { has_dynasty = yes }
	}
	allow = {
		oe_dyn2_can_dynastic_compact = yes
		prestige >= 20
		gold >= 100
	}
	ai_will_do = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = {
				gold >= 280
				prestige >= 35
			}
			add = 18
		}
	}
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	option = {
		name = oe_dyn2_dec_dynastic_house_compact.a
		effect = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_dec_compact_cd years = 12 }
			add_gold = -100
			add_prestige = 10
			add_legitimacy = 8
			ruler = {
				dynasty = {
					add_dynasty_modifier = { modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_dyn_sovereign_house years = 12 mode = replace }
				}
			}
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_dyn2_mod_house_compact_court years = 12 mode = replace }
			custom_tooltip = oe_dyn2_dec_dynastic_house_compact_tt
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dyn2_cd_ev1 } }
				set_variable = { name = oe_dyn2_cd_ev1 years = 20 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_dyn2.1
			}
		}
	}
}
